falseSynonyms.zh: contents 不等於所有 content contents 常指容器內的東西，或書籍的目錄／內容物；數碼『內容』通常用不可數 content。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Content is often uncountable information or media; contents often means things inside something or a table of contents.

falseSynonyms.zh: 數據不等於 content data 是可分析的數據／資料；content 可以包含文章、圖片、影片、意見等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Data can be part of content, but content is much broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 檔案不等於 content file 是儲存內容的數碼單位；同一內容可存在不同 file formats。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A file is a container or digital object; content is what it contains.

falseSynonyms.zh: 格式不等於 content format 是呈現／檔案形式，例如 PDF、video、HTML；content 是實際資訊或素材。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Format describes how something is presented, not what it says or contains.

falseSynonyms.zh: 設計不等於 content design 關乎版面、視覺、結構和體驗；content 關乎文字、資訊、影音等材料。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Design shapes presentation; content supplies the material or message.

falseSynonyms.zh: 廣告不等於所有 content 廣告是一種特定目的的內容；content 可以教育、娛樂、說明或記錄。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An advertisement is one type of content, not a general synonym.

falseSynonyms.zh: 訊息不等於所有 content message 是要傳達的核心意思；content 還包括細節、圖片、例子和形式素材。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A message is the main meaning; content can contain far more than the message.

falseSynonyms.zh: 注意同形異義詞 形容詞 content /kənˈtent/ 表示『滿足的』，和名詞 content /ˈkɒntent/『內容』不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The adjective content means satisfied; the noun content means material or information.
